nphi.title: Africa CDC Central Africa Regional Collaborating Centre (Libreville)
nphi.with: Government of Gabon (host of Central Africa RCC, Libreville)
nphi.summary: Africa CDC operationalised its Central Africa RCC in Libreville in 2017, with Gabon providing offices, an emergency operations centre and biosafety labs to serve nine Central African states.

nphi.title: ISCIII tropical medicine cooperation with Equatorial Guinea
nphi.actor: Instituto de Salud Carlos III (ISCIII) – Centro Nacional de Medicina Tropical
nphi.with: Ministry of Health and Social Welfare of Equatorial Guinea; Fundación CSAI
nphi.summary: ISCIII's National Centre for Tropical Medicine supports Equatorial Guinea's HIV, TB, malaria and NTD programmes and advises on hospital reference units; a 2024 institutional field visit reviewed the cooperation.

nphi.title: CDC support to Equatorial Guinea's Marburg virus disease response (2023)
nphi.with: Government of Equatorial Guinea (Ministry of Health); WHO
nphi.summary: At the government's request, CDC deployed viral haemorrhagic fever and laboratory experts who set up a mobile testing lab, trained local lab staff and advised on case finding during Equatorial Guinea's first Marburg outbreak…

nphi.title: TB-COVID – COVID-19 impact on TB programmes in West and Central Africa
nphi.with: WHO Global TB Programme; WHO/TDR; WARN-TB/CARN-TB; HISP, University of Oslo (Norway)
nphi.summary: Built NTP capacity to monitor and mitigate COVID-19 disruption to TB services via a framework, DHIS2 package and preparedness plans.

nphi.title: Mapping onchocerciasis, lymphatic filariasis and loiasis in continental Equatorial Guinea
nphi.with: MINSABS national onchocerciasis and filariasis control programme; Probitas Foundation; WHO ESPEN
nphi.summary: ISCIII-led project, co-funded by Probitas and WHO ESPEN, to map filarial diseases in continental Equatorial Guinea, evaluate new diagnostics and support control strategies with the national programme.
